summary: CLI iterations are passed unchanged to spmvGpu; CSR generation assigns n=floor(dim²/sparsity) entries and closes rowDelimiters[dim] at n. The selected short-row kernel is chosen by average n/dim into widths 2/4/8/16/32, with the long-row kernel selected at average>=256. Width-kernel grid is ceil(dim*width/128) and each active row accumulates j from rows[row]+lane to rows[row+1] in width strides before lane 0 stores; the long path launches one 128-thread block per row and accumulates j in 128 strides before reducing/storing. A warmup is synchronized before timing. If iterations>1, capture batch=min(iterations,128) launch calls. The timed host loop subtracts batch after each graph launch while remaining>=batch, then launches exactly the remaining direct calls; the event stop/sync follows. Compiled host code at c720 preserves the batch comparison/decrement/backedge and invokes the capture/launch closure; the closure contains the five width-specific cudaLaunchKernel paths and long-row launch. Inspected all six native sm86 variants: each short-row function has a bounded CSR traversal/backedge and output store; longRows has the 128-stride traversal, reduction and row store. No omission identified. The exceptional empty-dimension/zero-iteration early return does not enter timed work.
